top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two independently strong achievements with clean attribution: ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald and Hartwig), whose mechanism was established by isolating and characterising the palladium intermediates and which has been used independently for about three decades, and base editing (Liu), a designed and directed-evolved protein reagent for chemical conversion of DNA bases. Both fit the three-laureate limit per part; Kosugi priority is handled in citation wording. P005 (Liu alone) follows as the part of my configuration with the broadest support, then targeted protein degradation (P003), my stated alternative.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only a collegial Stockholm University tie to Secretary Peter Brzezinski, whose B032 appears in P004
